name: Prospector's Drill
description:
When the character to which this is attached takes DMG: If possible, Discard 1 card from your Hand with the highest Current Elemental Dice Cost to negate 1 DMG, and then gain 1 Solidarity point. (Once per Round)
When a character deals DMG: If there are Solidarity points already, consume all points and increase DMG dealt this instance by 1, then draw 1 card for each point consumed.
